guides.title: How to Make a Roblox Game
guides.description: From downloading Roblox Studio to publishing your first game live — no coding or experience needed. Covers building with free models, setting your age rating, and going public.

guides.title: What Does "Projected" Mean on Rolimons?
guides.description: A projected item has artificially inflated RAP — it looks valuable but sells for a fraction of the price. Learn to spot the warning tag and what to do if you have one.
